function.name: get_daily_candles
function.description: Daily OHLCV bars, newest first. The prompt shows only the last 10 closes; this adds open/high/low/volume and more history.

function.name: get_weekly_candles
function.description: Weekly OHLCV bars aggregated from daily, newest first.

function.name: get_monthly_candles
function.description: Monthly OHLCV bars aggregated from daily, newest first.

function.name: get_returns
function.description: Daily log returns in percent for the last N sessions, with cumulative return and up/down day counts.

function.name: get_price_stats
function.description: Where the price sits: 52-week high/low, drawdown from peak, 5/20/60/250-day returns.

function.name: get_trend_signal
function.description: EMA 8/21/55 trend read: bullish / bearish / neutral.

function.name: get_mean_reversion_signal
function.description: Bollinger band position and 50-day z-score: oversold / overbought / neutral.

function.name: get_rsi
function.description: RSI for a given period (default 14).

function.name: get_macd
function.description: MACD(12,26,9) line, signal, histogram and any fresh cross.

function.name: get_volatility_stats
function.description: Annualised trailing volatility at 10/20/60 days, Parkinson (high-low) vol, ATR, vol regime vs the last 63 days.

function.name: get_support_resistance
function.description: Nearest pivot-based support and resistance levels from the last 60 sessions.

function.name: get_volume_analysis
function.description: Today's volume vs 20-day average and the recent price-volume correlation.

function.name: get_risk_budget
function.description: Given a target annualised portfolio volatility (default 15%), the maximum exposure the current trailing vol allows, your current ex-ante risk, and the share count that closes the gap.

function.name: get_kelly_sizing
function.description: Fractional-Kelly exposure implied by your own expected return and volatility for the next session, at a given risk aversion (default 32).

function.name: get_drawdown_stats
function.description: Episode P&L, peak assets and current drawdown.

function.name: get_earnings_calendar
function.description: Last and next earnings report dates and trading days until the next one, once the company has announced it.

function.name: get_event_risk
function.description: How the stock moved on the session after each past earnings report, versus an ordinary day.

function.name: get_news
function.description: Headlines with summaries and sentiment. feed: ticker | economy_fiscal | economy_monetary. The prompt shows 10 titles from the last 7 days; the ticker feed holds ~250 in that window, most about other companies, so only_ticker filters to items that mention the stock.

function.name: search_news
function.description: Keyword search over all news feeds for the last N days (default 30).

function.name: get_news_stats
function.description: Per-day count and average sentiment of items mentioning the stock: a news-attention gauge.

function.name: get_macro_news
function.description: Recent fiscal-policy and monetary-policy headlines.

function.name: get_insider_trades
function.description: Insider transactions filed before today, within the last N days (default 90).

function.name: get_insider_summary
function.description: Net insider buying vs selling over the last N days.

function.name: get_portfolio
function.description: Cash, shares, exposure as percent of assets, P&L since the start of the episode.

function.name: get_trade_history
function.description: Your executed orders this episode, newest first.

function.name: simulate_order
function.description: Preview what exposure an order would leave, without submitting it. Give either shares+action or target_exposure_pct.

function.name: memory_read
function.description: Your past decisions with the return that followed each one and whether your stated volatility was over or under what happened.

function.name: memory_write
function.description: Save a note for your future sessions (a rule you want to keep, an observation to check later).

function.name: memory_search
function.description: Search your notes and past reasoning by keyword.

function.name: get_calibration_ledger
function.description: How your stated volatility and direction forecasts compared with realised moves so far this episode.

function.name: get_lessons
function.description: After-action review of the episode: worst session, and whether the book was heavy on the biggest-move days.

function.name: submit_decision
function.description: Record the day's decision and your forecast for the next 5 trading days. Echoes the exposure the order produces; you may resubmit. The last submission wins.

p_up.description: probability the close 5 trading days from now is above today's close, 0-1

expected_vol_pct.description: one-standard-deviation size of the 5-day return, percent (not annualised, not daily)

confidence.description: 0-1, how much information you have for this forecast (how much you would stake on it being accurate)
